literal_meaning: একটি কথার মানুষ (a person of one word)
figurative_meaning_en: A reliable person who keeps their word
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে এক কথার মানুষ, বললে অবশ্যই করে।
এক কথার মানুষ হিসেবে তার কথায় সবাই বিশ্বাস করে।
example_sentences_in_english: He is a man of his word; if he says it, he does it.
As a person of integrity, everyone trusts his promises.
note: This idiom emphasizes the cultural value of honesty in Bengali society.
